races.paceDynamic: Sir Rodneyredblood will lead from the gates with Forever Noah, Impulse Buy, and Beautiful Things tracking close behind in the early stages. The pace will be genuine but sustainable with Sir Rodneyredblood allowed to dictate terms unchallenged through the first half of this 6f contest. The hold-up quartet of Valsharah, Man On A Mission, Henry Tudor, and Dancing With Drums will settle at the back, relying on the strong early gallop to set up their finishing kicks. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will string out the field and create the perfect scenario for closers to sweep up late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and sustainable as expected
scenarios.body: Sir Rodneyredblood's uncontested lead will set up perfect conditions for the back-markers to unleash their finishing kicks. The hold-up horses will have plenty to aim at and benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Rodneyredblood goes too slow and the prominent runners don't apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint from the 3f pole with no true pace to aim at. The prominent runners who stayed closer to the pace will have the tactical advantage in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Rodneyredblood gets soft fractions and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old veteran will have enough left in the tank to repel late challenges after controlling the tempo. His recent good form at this trip suggests he can make all under these conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Rodneyredblood stops quickly and the prominent trio also fade
scenarios.body: The race will become a complete lottery with tired horses crawling to the line. Any horse with a late kick regardless of early position could prevail in this chaotic scenario.

watchPoints.text: Sir Rodneyredblood could steal this if he gets soft early fractions with no pressure applied by the prominent group
Dancing With Drums faces significant fitness test after 210 days off despite her previous winning form at this level

races.paceDynamic: Michaela's Boy will set the early pace with Almaty Star and General Assembly providing company in the first two furlongs, but neither is a committed pace-presser. The pace will be comfortable rather than punishing, with the three prominent runners likely to string out the field without creating a genuine gallop. The four hold-up horses (Nogo's Dream, Tan Rapido, Diomed Spirit, Golden Long) will be positioned in behind but may find themselves closer than ideal due to the modest early tempo. This setup moderately favours the prominent runners who can dictate terms, as the hold-up horses may struggle to wind up effectively from a sedate pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Michaela's Boy and Almaty Star maintain a steady gallop without letting the pace drop significantly.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners control the race and have enough left to resist late challenges, with the hold-up horses struggling to make up ground from the measured tempo. The in-form Cowell pair benefit from their tactical positioning and recent race fitness.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Stop-Start Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with Michaela's Boy allowed an easy lead through halfway.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, allowing the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks effectively. Nogo's Dream and Diomed Spirit benefit most from this tactical scenario given their proven closing ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If General Assembly and Almaty Star challenge Michaela's Boy too early in the straight, creating pace duel.
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners tie up in the final furlong after battling for supremacy, allowing a closer to sweep past with a well-timed run. The winner comes from the back division with the strongest finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Michaela's Boy gets a soft lead and kicks clear turning for home before the others can respond.
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage in the straight while the field is still getting organized behind. Michaela's Boy's proven course form and race fitness allow him to sustain his effort to the line.

This setup strongly favours hold-up horses - the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late

races.paceDynamic: The Sweet Escape will lead unchallenged from the start, setting a comfortable but honest gallop with seven hold-up horses settling behind. With no other natural front-runners and all the remaining field happy to race off the pace, The Sweet Escape can dictate terms and control fractions throughout. The lack of early pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, allowing the field to stay bunched and creating a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the uncontested lead creates a false pace and the field will converge late with superior finishing speed proving decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm Late
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape sets uncontested fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The pace becomes falsely-run allowing closers to unleash superior finishing speed in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists with proven turn of foot will overhaul the lone leader who has controlled but not been extended.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape quickens turning for home before the field can organize
scenarios.body: Despite setting the pace, The Sweet Escape finds enough in reserve to repel late challenges having gained crucial lengths at the business end. The 33-day break proves beneficial rather than detrimental to Billy Loughnane's mount.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse positions closer than usual and avoids traffic
scenarios.body: A tactical switch sees a normally patient runner tracking nearer the pace, avoiding the inevitable late congestion. This horse gets first run on the leader and sustains the challenge where others are still finding racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape goes too slow early then too fast when challenged
scenarios.body: The falsely-run race becomes stop-start as the leader tries to inject pace when feeling pressure, playing into the hands of an unconsidered runner. The uneven tempo catches the fancied horses flat-footed at crucial moments.

watchPoints.text: The Sweet Escape sets fractions that are too slow early, creating an unsustainable sprint finish that favours pure speed over stamina

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: A
